name: Material Availability Field Settings
summary: System-scoped settings page that controls which Material Availability work-order fields are shown in the dialog UI, which fields are included in print output, and whether the Show all chip can reveal logic-only fields.

userActions: Enable or disable the Show all chip
Choose which work-order fields are visible in the dialog
Reset the Material Availability field settings to defaults
preserveRules: Keep persistence routed through Settings.Core definitions
Keep field IDs aligned with the ShipRec Material Availability field catalog
Keep logic-only fields available for calculations even when hidden by default
validationHints: Confirm save writes the UI-visible field list, print-visible field list, and Show all chip toggle
Confirm reset restores the default field selections from the manifest-backed definitions
Confirm the Material Availability work-order dialog honors the configured UI and print selections
